style: Cute anime sticker avatar, flat vector illustration with a thick white die-cut outline around the character, chibi head-and-shoulders proportions, all characters are girls. Art direction: warm cheerful medieval-fantasy adventure anime look, delicate clean thin lineart, soft pastel palette, European fantasy costume details kept simple. GENKI energetic, hardworking and happy mood: bright wide-open sparkling eyes with big glossy highlights looking directly at the viewer, warm open smile, light blush on cheeks, a small fist-pump or thumbs-up near the face, tiny sparkle effort marks around the head. Original character, not any existing franchise character. Bold simple shapes, readable at 32x32 pixels. Solid dark navy (#14161c) background, centered, no text, no watermark
